# A11y Audit v0.4.1 - Table of Contents

Automated accessibility testing for Elixir web applications using axe-core

## Pages

- [A11yAudit](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [A11yAudit.Assertions](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Assertions.md): ExUnit assertions
- [A11yAudit.Hound](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Hound.md): ExUnit assertions for Hound tests
- [A11yAudit.JS](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.JS.md): axe-core JavaScript source
- [A11yAudit.Results](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Results.md): Corresponds to axe-core's results object.
Some fields omitted.
- [A11yAudit.Results.Node](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Results.Node.md): Corresponds to a single object in axe-core's nodes array of the violations array.
Some fields omitted.
- [A11yAudit.Results.Violation](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Results.Violation.md): Corresponds to a single object in axe-core's violations array of the results object.
Some fields omitted.
- [A11yAudit.ViolationFilter](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.ViolationFilter.md): A behavior for excluding certain violations from the results.
- [A11yAudit.Wallaby](https://a11y-audit.hexdocs.pm/A11yAudit.Wallaby.md): ExUnit assertions for Wallaby tests
